children: Shares of Adani Power gained on Wednesday October 14, after the company announced it had received a Letter of Award (LoA) from Uttarakhand Power Corporation Ltd (UPCL) to supply thermal power for 25 years.
The LoA covers the supply of 1,234 MW of thermal power, from a plant with 1,320 MW of installed capacity, according to a regulatory filing on Wednesday.
UPCL issued the award on Tuesday, October 13, after trading hours, the filing said.
The award follows another major announcement last week
Last week, Adani Power disclosed that it had signed a shareholders' agreement with Bhutan's Druk Green Power Corp to jointly develop the 770 MW Chamkharchhu-I Hydroelectric Project.
Under a 49:51 equity split, the two companies would build the facility in Bhutan's Zhemgang District, using a Build, Own, Operate and Transfer model, the filing said.

The project follows an earlier venture launched in late 2025 and forms part of a broader 5,000 MW bilateral renewable energy framework. The facility is expected to meet Bhutan's winter energy needs and supply surplus clean electricity to India during the summer.
Adani Power shares were trading 1.5% higher at ₹188.75 around 11.50 am on Wednesday. The stock has gained about 27% in the year-to-date period and close to 22% over the trailing 12 months.

title: Adani Power shares gain on 1,234 MW thermal power LoA from Uttarakhand Power Corporation
